    if total == 0:

    first_pass = sum(1 for p in prs if p["architect_rounds"] == 1 and p["outcome"] == "approved")
    first_pass_rate = (first_pass / total) * 100
    human = sum(1 for p in prs if p["outcome"] == "human_intervention")

            "first_pass_rate": m_fp_rate,
            "human_rate": m_hi_rate
        }
    return {
        "total": total,
        "avg_rounds": avg_rounds,
        "first_pass_rate": first_pass_rate,
        "human_rate": human_rate,
        "by_model": by_model
    }

prs_prev_7d = [p for p in completed_prs if t_14d <= p["dt"] < t_7d]
prs_30d = [p for p in completed_prs if p["dt"] >= t_30d]

[\`scripts/liveness.py:_check_success()\`](https://github.com/matthewmcneill/bug-fixer-loop-plugin/blob/main/scripts/liveness.py#L543-L587) checks whether a \`fresh_fix\` or \`reattach\` dispatch succeeded by querying whether the target issue has the \`bug-fixer:architect:awaiting-review\` label:

\`\`\`python
r = _gh(\"issue\", \"view\", str(issue_num), \"--repo\", target_repo,
        \"--json\", \"labels\", \"--jq\",
        '[.labels[].name] | any(. == \"bug-fixer:architect:awaiting-review\")')
return r.stdout.strip() == \"true\"
\`\`\`

However, it does **not** check whether the issue is still \`OPEN\`. If a closed issue retains the \`bug-fixer:architect:awaiting-review\` label (which happens when PRs are merged without label cleanup), \`_check_success()\` returns \`True\` for any dispatch referencing that issue — including stale or accidentally restored dispatch files.

### Evidence

On 2026-10-05, a historical dispatch file (\`44ba2163-...\`) referencing closed Issue #13 was accidentally restored via a git commit. When \`sweep_dispatches()\` processed it, \`_check_success()\` returned \`True\` because Issue #13 (closed 2026-10-02) still had the \`bug-fixer:architect:awaiting-review\` label. This triggered \`_append_to_ledger()\`, writing three phantom entries to \`pr_completions.jsonl\` with \`pr: null\`, \`outcome: pending\`, and \`architect_rounds: 0\`.

### Proposed Fix

Add a state check to the \`fresh_fix\` / \`reattach\` branch:

\`\`\`python
if dtype in (\"fresh_fix\", \"reattach\"):
    issue_num = dispatch.get(\"issue_number\")
    if not issue_num:
        return False
    r = _gh(\"issue\", \"view\", str(issue_num), \"--repo\", target_repo,
            \"--json\", \"state,labels\", \"--jq\",
            '.state == \"OPEN\" and ([.labels[].name] | any(. == \"bug-fixer:architect:awaiting-review\"))')
    return r.stdout.strip() == \"true\"
\`\`\`

This ensures only actively open issues can signal completion.

### Additional Hardening

Consider also adding \`state == \"OPEN\"\` checks to the \`pr_iteration\` and \`architect_review\` branches (checking PR state is not \`CLOSED\` or \`MERGED\` for iterations, ensuring the PR is still relevant for architect review).
